title: Origin story: Ashenlord
description: Ashenlord was the keeper of the eternal flame's ashes, the one who tended what remained when the great fire died. He learned that ash remembers warmth, and that endings kept warm can kindle beginnings. He walks the world's cold places with a brazier of remembered fire, warming the ends of things.
